description: What undo means to the page (ui/src/lib/rollback.ts): the plan of one step, of the ticked files of a checkpoint and of a task, the words for a plan and for what happened, the code of an error, the record of the last restore and its keeping across a reload, and which receipts can be undone. Judged by ui/tests/rollback.test.mjs; tests/ui-rollback-for-mutation.mjs runs that file in the copy of the Hub that the runner makes.

mutations.name: step-drops-the-conflict-branch
mutations.what: a file changed after the step is put back over

mutations.name: step-unknown-is-a-conflict
mutations.what: a file for which the Hub noted nothing is left alone as if it had changed

mutations.name: step-unknown-not-marked
mutations.what: a file whose step is unknown is not marked as one

mutations.name: step-expects-the-baseline
mutations.what: each file is expected to have the sha of the copy, not the sha it has

patches.old: else addRow(plan, file, file.currentSha, { changedLater: false, stepUnknown: file.changedSinceStep === null });
patches.new: else addRow(plan, file, file.baselineSha, { changedLater: false, stepUnknown: file.changedSinceStep === null });

mutations.name: step-plans-unchanged-files
mutations.what: a file that is already right is planned

mutations.name: selection-takes-everything
mutations.what: a file that was not ticked is restored too

mutations.name: selection-forgets-later-changes
mutations.what: a file changed after the step that made the checkpoint is not said to be

mutations.name: selection-expects-the-baseline
mutations.what: a ticked file is expected to have the sha of the copy

patches.old: else addRow(plan, file, file.currentSha, { changedLater: file.changedSinceStep === true
patches.new: else addRow(plan, file, file.baselineSha, { changedLater: file.changedSinceStep === true

mutations.name: task-undoes-files-the-review-does-not-show
mutations.what: a file that is not in the review is undone behind the person's back

mutations.name: task-conflict-inverted
mutations.what: the file that is what the review showed is the conflict

mutations.name: task-expects-the-file-now
mutations.what: a row of the task is expected to have the sha of the preview rather than the review's
mutations.equivalent: a row is only made when the review's sha equals the preview's, so the two are the same sha

patches.old: else addRow(plan, file, reviewShas[file.path], { changedLater: false, stepUnknown: false });
patches.new: else addRow(plan, file, file.currentSha, { changedLater: false, stepUnknown: false });

mutations.name: names-cut-after-seven

mutations.name: names-more-not-counted

mutations.name: words-wrong-row-text

mutations.name: words-no-incomplete-note

patches.old: return record && record.workspace === workspace && wellFormed(record.last) ? record.last : null;

patches.old: return record && record.workspace === workspace && wellFormed(record.last) ? record.last : null;
